response.sql:
WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
), per_town AS (
  SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS average_price, AVG(avg_cost_ratio) AS average_ratio
  FROM per_item
  GROUP BY town_city
), with_baseline AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS cross_town_average_ratio
  FROM per_town
)
SELECT town_city, average_price, average_ratio,
       average_ratio - cross_town_average_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM with_baseline
WHERE average_ratio > cross_town_average_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: A ratio is treated as missing when either cost value is missing or derived_total_cost is zero; NULLIF prevents division by zero. Towns with no non-missing ratio do not contribute to the cross-town average.
